canonical_project: Meghalaya State Data Centre (MSDC), NIC Building, Shillong
owner: Department of IT & C, Government of Meghalaya / Meghalaya Information Technology Society
notes: Official DIT page (live, re-verified 2026-08-12): MSDC inaugurated 17 Aug 2011, ~1,800 sq ft on 2nd floor of NIC Building, Shillong (East Khasi Hills); ISO/IEC 20000:2011 and 27001:2013 certified; connected to MSWAN; hosts 32+ state e-governance applications; DR replication to NIC National Data Centre New Delhi. NIC informatics news (2012) and IPinfo ASN148859 corroborate the facility.
